newsitem.title: USA: 2Connect sees losses until enough stores open.
newsitem.headline: 2Connect sees losses until enough stores open.

text.p: 2Connect Express Inc CNTC.O said Monday that, consistent with most start-up retailers, it will incur costs, expenses, and losses until it operates enough stores that would offset its operating and expansion costs.

The company issued the statement as it reported a net loss of $804,000, or $0.27 a share for the second quarter of 1997, compared to a net loss of $415,000 or $0.15 a share in the first quarter of 1997. Net loss for the short period from April 19 to June 30, 1996 was $51,000, or ($0.03) per share.
It said that sales for the latest quarter were $774,000 compared to $257,000 for the first quarter.
Marc Fishman, president and chief executive officer, said the higher net loss for the second quarter 1997 was expected due to the company's early stage of development.

2Connect was founded in April 1996 and went public in May this year. It is a specialty retailer of communications related products and services. The company currently operates four stores in South Florida and plans six additional stores by November.
